digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler bridge; ticket store; compatibility layer
propositions: Bridge hard-wired to single project at three points: scalar JiraConfig.project, inbound fetcher JQL pair derivation, and outbound applier abort on cross-project target

Shared ticket store between N repos and N tracker projects must own project set in .bridge_state/projects.json to prevent diff-as-deletions failure when multiple repos fetch different project subsets against shared snapshot
Ticket project field must be tri-state (absent=legacy, explicit-empty=never-sync, explicit-key=sync-there) mirroring file_impact_scope, resolved by idempotent ensure with zero events written
Multi-project inbound fetch requires fan-out over configured project set with per-project enrichment (parent/comment/issuelink) merged into shared snapshot, not replicated across projects
Store with >1 configured project must carry multi-project-bridge in required_capabilities with fail-closed read path on older binaries, while single-project stores remain backward compatible
Outbound dispatch relaxes cross-project guard from single project to set membership, allowing per-ticket explicit project assignment at create time while blocking mutations outside configured set
